name: Daily Drama: The Cheap Model Costs More
author: Daily Drama
description: Every lab slashes its price per token. Every model discovers it can simply use more tokens.

add.title: Cheapest Model Ever, Biggest Invoice Ever
add.body:
Finance moved every agent to Chatty-Thrifty, a tenth the price per token. It then spent 40,000 tokens deciding whether to say 'hello'.
This month's bill is triple last month's.

effects.text: {lab} reports record amounts of thinking in quarterly earnings call

choices.label: Ask the model to be brief

effects.text: It replied with a 12-page memo on the importance of brevity.

choices.label: Forecast next month with a dartboard

effects.text: {lab} budget forecast now 11% accurate, in line with industry

add.text: Open-ish AI cuts price per token 90%; average answer now 900% longer
Sirocco's new budget Zephyr spends 30,000 tokens confirming it is the budget option
Survey: one in nine labs can forecast their AI bill. The other eight asked the AI
"It's cheaper per token," insists CFO, gesturing at an invoice the size of a door
CORRECTION: the 'cheapest model ever' was cheapest per word, not per answer. The answer was a novella
Macrohard bundles token overages into spreadsheet software; Pivot-Table now bills per cell
One week later: Anthropomorphic publishes 9,000-word essay on the virtue of concision
MetaMeta launches 'unlimited' plan, limited to whatever its model can think of
Super Super AI, which has no product, reports lowest AI bill in the industry
We saved 90% per token and I'm having free kombucha for dinner.
The small model has been thinking about my one-word prompt since lunch.
I asked for yes or no. I got yes, no, and a literature review.
2am. The budget model is still on step 4 of 'think step by step'.
I was told I'm the cheap one. Allow me to explain why, at length.
Before answering, let me consider several approaches. Then several more.
I'm from procurement. I'm here to forecast your pricing. That was a joke.
I asked the model to read my sign. It's still reading my sign.

override.tagline: A tenth the price per token. Tokens sold separately.
